# Mythborn

> Mythborn is an emerging collectible universe built around numbered artifacts, wearable symbols, story fragments and limited releases.

## Official Website

- [Mythborn](https://mythborn.co/)

## About Mythborn

Mythborn is preparing its first artifact: a limited, numbered object positioned somewhere between a collectible, a wearable symbol and a physical fragment of a fictional world.

The first release will have a name, a number and a story. It may be worn, displayed or preserved as part of a collection.

## Current Status

- Chapter 00 is live.
- The first artifact has not yet been revealed.
- Early-access registration is available.
- Future releases may be limited and may not return in the same form.
